newsitem.title: CHINA: Valeo in $49.9 mln Shanghai car engine JV.
newsitem.headline: Valeo in $49.9 mln Shanghai car engine JV.

text.p: Valeo International Holding DV has signed an agreement with Shanghai Automotive Electrical Works to set up a $49.9 million joint venture to produce car engines, an official with the venture said on Wednesday.
Valeo holds 70 percent of shares in the venture, Shanghai Valeo Co, while its Shanghai partner, a subsidiary of Shanghai Automotive Industrial (Group) Corp, holds 30 percent, the official said.
Construction of the new firm's production facility started in late March in the Zhangjiang High-tech Development Zone in the Pudong New Area to the east of central Shanghai, she said.
The joint venture is expected to start production in May, 1998, and annual capacity is desiged at 1.6 million car engines, she said.
She said the engines would be for use in small sedan cars.
